subject: Medford Square Rezoning
overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board met in a joint session to establish rules of order and conduct a public hearing on proposed zoning amendments for the Medford Square district. Both bodies adopted the joint session rules and voted to continue the public hearing to February 25, 2026.

items.title: Paper 26-022: Joint Session Rules Resolution
items.summary: Approved the resolution to adopt rules of order governing joint sessions between the City Council and the Community Development Board.

items.title: Paper 26-023: Proposed Amendments to Medford Zoning Ordinance - Medford Square
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on proposed zoning ordinance and map amendments for the Medford Square mixed-use district to February 25, 2026, following a consultant presentation and discussion regarding boundaries, parking, and historic preservation.
